understanding.purpose: 展示五项财务指标在 2022—2024 年的变化，以及同比结果和备注。
understanding.reading: 读者先按行识别指标，再横向比较三个年度的数值和同比变化；备注提供补充解释。
groups: 第 2—4 列都是年度数值，应保持一致的宽度和对齐方式，方便跨年比较。
第 5 列是变化结果，与年度数值相邻，便于核对趋势。
第 1 列标识指标，第 6 列提供说明，分别承担识别和解释作用。
keep_intact: 同比变化数值及其单位或符号
may_wrap: 指标名称可在自然语义边界换行。
备注中的说明文字可以自然换行；同一行较高时可容纳这些换行。

preferred.name: r3C
preferred.note: 保留较紧凑的年度列以改善首屏可见范围，将部分宽度转给备注；指标列略窄于r2A，检验标签换行是否仍自然，并与年份表头单行的方案比较。

acceptable.name: r1C
acceptable.note: 在r0B和r0C之间折中，加宽指标和备注以改善行内文字节奏，总宽555px；首屏能看到三个年度，但同比需滚动查看。

acceptable.name: r2A
acceptable.note: 保留r1A较好的指标和备注宽度，将三个年度列统一缩至66px；每列仍有45px内容宽度，足以容纳所给年度表头与不可拆分数值，并让初始视口显示更多同比信息。

acceptable.name: r2B
acceptable.note: 将指标列压至86px，使指标、三个年度及同比恰好合计359px；备注通过横向滚动查看。以指标名称更多换行为代价，测试首屏完整比较数据的价值。

acceptable.name: r2C
acceptable.note: 加宽指标列以改善较长名称和单位的连续性，同时收紧等宽年度列；测试更清晰的行标识是否值得增加横向滚动。

acceptable.name: r3A
acceptable.note: 以r2A为基础，将三年列统一加宽至78px，使57px的年份表头能够一行显示；保留指标和同比的完整性，接受更多横向滚动。

acceptable.name: r3B
acceptable.note: 保持年份表头完整，并把备注列加宽至150px，检验较长说明能否减少换行和行高；代价是滚动距离增加。

bad.name: r1B
bad.note: 压缩指标列并适度加宽备注列，总宽504px。首屏仍可看到三个完整年度，并露出更多同比列；代价是较长指标名称需要换行。
bad.why: The narrow indicator and remarks columns produce rows as tall as four lines. The long indicator breaks into several short fragments, weakening the row’s identity while the wider year columns push the comparison column mostly outside the viewport.

rationale: r3C keeps the three years equal in width and brings almost all of the year-over-year column into the initial viewport, making the main financial comparisons visible together. Indicator labels remain readable, and the wider remarks column limits the table’s height without requiring excessive horizontal scrolling. The year headers occupy two lines, a consistent cost across three equivalent columns.

general: Give columns with the same comparative role a consistent width so readers can scan across them easily.
Judge horizontal scrolling by which information is visible together, not just by total overflow.
Allow enough width for row labels to remain recognizable and for related values to read as a unit.
specific: The three annual columns can be narrowed equally without splitting the financial values, although their headers then wrap.
Keeping the year-over-year figures near the viewport edge is valuable because they summarize the change across the annual figures.
Remarks need more width than individual numeric columns because their longer prose otherwise drives row height.

tradeoffs: r3A and r3B retain single-line year headers, but place more of the year-over-year column outside the initial view. r2B brings that column fully into view at the cost of more fragmented indicator labels; r3B gives remarks more breathing room at the cost of additional scrolling.
uncertain: A designer could reasonably prefer unwrapped year headers or a shorter table over seeing more of the year-over-year figures initially. The ranges are approximate and should be checked in the browser, especially at wrapping thresholds; they assume coordinated adjustments that preserve the equal year-column widths.

critique.good: 整表基本落在首屏，指标、年度、同比和备注都能看到。
critique.problems: 年份表头、年度数值和同比数值被拆开；备注逐字堆叠，使行高悬殊，横向比较很吃力。
critique.cause: 年度列各仅52px，同比列54px，扣除内边距后不足以容纳完整数字或年份；备注列64px也过窄。

critique.good: 年度列等宽，年份和数值保持完整；首屏能看到三个年度，指标列仍有足够空间辨认名称。
critique.problems: 同比和备注需要横向滚动；长备注形成较高的行，指标名称也有多处换行。
critique.cause: 年度列各78px保证了表头完整，但表格总宽500px；备注列85px限制了说明文字的每行字数，指标列105px也容不下较长名称。

critique.good: 指标和备注更舒展，行高较低，完整表格的阅读节奏清晰；数字和表头保持完整。
critique.problems: 首屏在2024年列附近结束，同比和备注都在屏外；250px的横向溢出增加了查看完整一行的滚动距离。
critique.cause: 指标列和备注列各150px，改善了换行，但把总宽度推至610px。

critique.good: 年度列等宽，表头和数字完整，便于逐行比较；指标列大多能将名称与单位分行，阅读顺序清楚。
critique.problems: 初始视口只显示同比列的一小部分，备注需要横向滚动；经营性现金流一行的指标名称被拆开，较高的行也让数字之间出现较多空白。
critique.cause: 三个年度列各占78px，连同105px的指标列，已占339px；指标列的84px内容宽度又不足以完整容纳较长名称。

critique.good: 相比r1A，总宽减少30px，年度列仍然等宽，数值和表头保持完整，初始视口能看到稍多的同比列。
critique.problems: 指标名称和单位被切得更碎，资产负债率也换行；多行过高，数字列中的空白削弱了行的连续性，备注仍需横向滚动。
critique.cause: 指标列降至90px，仅有69px内容宽度；备注列降至105px，也增加了说明文字换行，两者共同拉高部分行。

critique.good: 较宽的指标列让经营性现金流的名称保持在一起；年度列整齐，表格高度也与r1A相同。
critique.problems: 营业收入和研发投入的单位被拆行；初始视口几乎只容纳指标和三个年度，同比与备注都需要滚动才能阅读。额外的指标列宽度没有带来更紧凑的整体。
critique.cause: 125px指标列的104px内容宽度恰好使部分名称后的单位落在行尾并被拆开；它比r1A多占20px，进一步挤出同比列。

critique.good: 三年数值列等宽，便于横向比较；指标名称和数值没有词中拆分，行内关系较清楚。
critique.problems: 三个年份表头都分成两行，首屏仅能看到同比列的一部分，备注需要横向滚动。较长的指标名称和备注使部分行达到三行。
critique.cause: 年度列各为66px，扣除21px内边距和边框后不足以容纳57px的年份表头；指标列105px、备注列120px限制了长文本的行宽。

critique.good: 年度列保持一致，数值与同比结果仍完整；总宽比r2A少19px，首屏能看到更多右侧内容。
critique.problems: 指标名称换行更零碎，经营性现金流及其单位被拆到多行，资产负债率也被拆开；末行因此变高，识别指标的速度下降。年份表头仍分两行。
critique.cause: 指标列从105px缩至86px，可用文本宽度只有65px；年度列仍为66px，放不下一行年份表头。

critique.good: 较宽的指标列让大多数指标名称保持一行，标签易于识别；年度列等宽，数值比较清楚。
critique.problems: 首屏几乎看不到同比结果，滚动距离最长；表格高度与r2A相同，额外的指标列宽没有缩短整表。年份表头仍分两行。
critique.cause: 指标列增至145px，将同比和备注进一步推到视口之外；年度列仍为66px，而较长备注仍会决定部分行高。

review.method: two fresh-context blind reviews; letters shuffled; includes browser auto layout and equal widths as neutral references

ref_equal.why: The narrow columns split percentages, pp units, year headers and metric names. Notes become long vertical stacks, making rows difficult to scan.

r2A.why: Metric names and values remain mostly intact, and the compact rows support comparison. The change column sits at the viewport edge, while notes require horizontal scrolling.

ref_auto.why: The numeric values stay intact, but narrow metric and note columns produce tall rows and heavily fragmented Chinese text. Notes also extend beyond the viewport.

r3C.why: The three years and metric names form a readable, compact comparison. The change column is at the viewport edge and notes require scrolling.

r1B.why: The year headers and values read clearly, but the change column is mostly outside the viewport. Tall rows and the wrapped cash-flow label weaken the compact comparison.

r1C.why: The three years fit cleanly with mostly readable metric names, but both the change column and notes lie outside the initial viewport, hiding useful context.

raw.unsure: The offscreen note columns are not visible in these images, so their readability and the full scrolling distance are difficult to judge.

r2A.why: The metrics and annual figures scan clearly, with intact values and manageable label wrapping. The year headings wrap, and the notes require horizontal scrolling.

ref_equal.why: Fitting all six columns into the viewport breaks percentages and identifiers across lines. Narrow metric and note columns make rows exceptionally tall and difficult to compare.

r1C.why: The three years have clear, single-line headings and intact values, and the metric labels remain reasonably readable. Year-over-year changes and notes require horizontal scrolling.

ref_auto.why: The financial values remain intact, but the metric and note columns are so narrow that words fragment and rows become very tall. The notes extend beyond the initial viewport.

r3C.why: The metrics, annual figures and changes are compact and mostly easy to compare. Wrapped year headings and the off-screen notes are the main costs.

r1B.why: Single-line year headings and intact figures aid comparison, but narrow metric labels wrap awkwardly and tall rows weaken the scanning rhythm. Changes and notes require scrolling.

raw.unsure: The supplied views do not show the full width of the scrolled content clearly, so the readability of the notes and the total scrolling distance are uncertain.

provenance.note: AI visual design judgement; not a human reading study
